Name: Some Music 2 for Content Patcher
Author: Gipop
Description:
!!! 1.6 UPDATE !!!

The 1.6 update took me somewhat by surprise. The mod that made my mod work is no longer relevant and when it will be updated is not known (if it will at all).
I just recently learnt that Content Patcher now supports the ability to replace sounds in the game, but I have not been able to figure out how it all works.

But thanks to the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20489?tab=posts]Thunder and Frogs Sounds[/url] I finally figured it all out and now music is back in the game!
A huge thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/87602513]chrisdegod[/url] for his help (even though he didn't know about it)!

The list of changed music. Music was created by [url=https://www.youtube.com/c/OakStudiosNoCopyrightMusic]"Oak Studio"[/url], which gave permission to use its music for non-commercial purposes.
